title: Fifty-two submarines lost
text:
Fifty-two United States submarines were lost during the Second World War. The causes ranged from enemy action to operational casualties, and for many boats the cause was never established because no one survived to report it.

This is a sample record drawn from the public-domain 1946 Navy publication. The full corpus is in corpora/.
